title: Tamma agent result artifact
description: The .tamma/result.json a Tamma runner uploads as the `tamma-result` artifact. Decoded by AgentResultArtifactParser.ParseResultJson and merged by ActionsResultAggregator. The key set is pinned three ways — this schema, collect-results.sh's TAMMA_RESULT_KEYS, and the AgentResultArtifact record — by RunnerContractTests; changing one without the others fails Tamma's build.

success.description: The agent's own verdict. Authoritative: the collector trusts this over the workflow run conclusion.

task.description: Echo of the `task` input (implement, fix, debug, review, test).

branch_name.description: Echo of the `branch_name` input — the branch the run pushed to.

tamma_session_id.description: Echo of the `tamma_session_id` input. Correlates the run with Tamma's audit trail.

files_changed.description: Repository-relative paths this run changed. Capped at MaxFilesChangedCount; the collector falls back to a git diff when empty.

pr_number.description: Null in the per-task call — the Tamma cycle opens the PR before the task loop, and the collector looks it up from git.

commit_sha.description: HEAD after the run. Empty when nothing was committed.

error_message.description: Why the run failed. Null on success. Must never carry secrets or source.

agent_log_summary.description: Tail of the agent log. Truncated to MaxAgentLogSummaryChars server-side.

tokens_used.description: Total agent tokens. 0 when the provider does not report usage.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from workspace prepare to collect.

agent_version.description: Version string of the agent CLI that ran. Null when unknown.
